plain_comments: # CrowdSec 每日规则库与黑名单自动同步

rules.iptables:
-P INPUT ACCEPT
-P FORWARD ACCEPT
-P OUTPUT ACCEPT
-N 1PANEL_BASIC
-N 1PANEL_BASIC_AFTER
-N 1PANEL_BASIC_BEFORE
-N CROWDSEC_CHAIN
-N DOCKER
-N DOCKER-BRIDGE
-N DOCKER-CT
-N DOCKER-FORWARD
-N DOCKER-INTERNAL
-N DOCKER-USER
-A INPUT -j CROWDSEC_CHAIN
-A INPUT -j 1PANEL_BASIC_BEFORE
-A INPUT -j 1PANEL_BASIC
-A INPUT -j 1PANEL_BASIC_AFTER
-A FORWARD -j CROWDSEC_CHAIN
-A FORWARD -j DOCKER-USER
-A FORWARD -j DOCKER-FORWARD
-A 1PANEL_BASIC -p udp -m udp --dport 443 -m comment --comment "1panel-rule:00000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000001" -j ACCEPT
-A 1PANEL_BASIC -p tcp -m tcp --dport 443 -m comment --comment "1panel-rule:00000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000002" -j ACCEPT
-A 1PANEL_BASIC -p tcp -m tcp --dport 80 -m comment --comment "1panel-rule:00000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000003" -j ACCEPT
-A 1PANEL_BASIC_AFTER -p tcp -j DROP
-A 1PANEL_BASIC_AFTER -p udp -j DROP
-A 1PANEL_BASIC_BEFORE -p tcp -m tcp --dport 53322 -j ACCEPT
-A 1PANEL_BASIC_BEFORE -p tcp -m tcp --dport 29726 -j ACCEPT
-A 1PANEL_BASIC_BEFORE -i lo -m comment --comment "Loopback Whitelist" -j ACCEPT
-A 1PANEL_BASIC_BEFORE -m conntrack --ctstate RELATED,ESTABLISHED -m comment --comment "ESTABLISHED Whitelist" -j ACCEPT
-A CROWDSEC_CHAIN -m set --match-set crowdsec-blacklists-1 src -m comment --comment "CrowdSec: crowdsec" -j DROP
-A CROWDSEC_CHAIN -m set --match-set crowdsec-blacklists-0 src -m comment --comment "CrowdSec: CAPI" -j DROP
-A DOCKER -d 172.18.0.4/32 ! -i br-c6dd5b027681 -o br-c6dd5b027681 -p tcp -m tcp --dport 6379 -j ACCEPT
-A DOCKER -d 172.18.0.5/32 ! -i br-c6dd5b027681 -o br-c6dd5b027681 -p tcp -m tcp --dport 8080 -j ACCEPT
-A DOCKER -d 172.18.0.6/32 ! -i br-c6dd5b027681 -o br-c6dd5b027681 -p tcp -m tcp --dport 9000 -j ACCEPT
-A DOCKER -d 172.19.0.3/32 ! -i br-54cc39b0fbf4 -o br-54cc39b0fbf4 -p tcp -m tcp --dport 4322 -j ACCEPT
-A DOCKER -d 172.18.0.2/32 ! -i br-c6dd5b027681 -o br-c6dd5b027681 -p tcp -m tcp --dport 3306 -j ACCEPT
-A DOCKER ! -i br-54cc39b0fbf4 -o br-54cc39b0fbf4 -j DROP
-A DOCKER ! -i br-c6dd5b027681 -o br-c6dd5b027681 -j DROP
-A DOCKER ! -i docker0 -o docker0 -j DROP
-A DOCKER-BRIDGE -o br-54cc39b0fbf4 -j DOCKER
-A DOCKER-BRIDGE -o br-c6dd5b027681 -j DOCKER
-A DOCKER-BRIDGE -o docker0 -j DOCKER
-A DOCKER-CT -o br-54cc39b0fbf4 -m conntrack --ctstate RELATED,ESTABLISHED -j ACCEPT
-A DOCKER-CT -o br-c6dd5b027681 -m conntrack --ctstate RELATED,ESTABLISHED -j ACCEPT
-A DOCKER-CT -o docker0 -m conntrack --ctstate RELATED,ESTABLISHED -j ACCEPT
-A DOCKER-FORWARD -j DOCKER-CT
-A DOCKER-FORWARD -j DOCKER-INTERNAL
-A DOCKER-FORWARD -j DOCKER-BRIDGE
-A DOCKER-FORWARD -i br-54cc39b0fbf4 -j ACCEPT
-A DOCKER-FORWARD -i br-c6dd5b027681 -j ACCEPT
-A DOCKER-FORWARD -i docker0 -j ACCEPT
-A DOCKER-USER -j CROWDSEC_CHAIN
rules.ip6tables:
-P INPUT ACCEPT
-P FORWARD ACCEPT
-P OUTPUT ACCEPT
-N 1PANEL_BASIC

-A INPUT -j 1PANEL_BASIC_AFTER
-A FORWARD -j CROWDSEC_CHAIN
-A FORWARD -j DOCKER-USER
-A FORWARD -j DOCKER-FORWARD
-A 1PANEL_BASIC -p udp -m udp --dport 443 -m comment --comment "1panel-rule:00000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000004" -j ACCEPT
-A 1PANEL_BASIC -p tcp -m tcp --dport 443 -m comment --comment "1panel-rule:00000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000005" -j ACCEPT
-A 1PANEL_BASIC -p tcp -m tcp --dport 80 -m comment --comment "1panel-rule:00000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000006" -j ACCEPT
-A 1PANEL_BASIC_AFTER -p tcp -j DROP
-A 1PANEL_BASIC_AFTER -p udp -j DROP
-A 1PANEL_BASIC_BEFORE -p tcp -m tcp --dport 53322 -j ACCEPT
-A 1PANEL_BASIC_BEFORE -p tcp -m tcp --dport 29726 -j ACCEPT
-A 1PANEL_BASIC_BEFORE -i lo -m comment --comment "Loopback Whitelist" -j ACCEPT
-A 1PANEL_BASIC_BEFORE -m conntrack --ctstate RELATED,ESTABLISHED -m comment --comment "ESTABLISHED Whitelist" -j ACCEPT
-A CROWDSEC_CHAIN -m set --match-set crowdsec6-blacklists-1 src -m comment --comment "CrowdSec: CAPI" -j DROP
-A CROWDSEC_CHAIN -m set --match-set crowdsec6-blacklists-0 src -m comment --comment "CrowdSec: crowdsec" -j DROP
-A DOCKER-FORWARD -j DOCKER-CT
-A DOCKER-FORWARD -j DOCKER-INTERNAL
-A DOCKER-FORWARD -j DOCKER-BRIDGE
-A DOCKER-USER -j CROWDSEC_CHAIN
